# Bluewater Post-Acute

> Bluewater Post-Acute is an 88-bed skilled nursing and short-term rehabilitation facility at 440 Phippen Waiters Road, Dania Beach, FL 33004. Phone (954) 927-0508. Formerly Westlake Nursing and Rehab Center; now under new ownership with a new leadership team.

- Accepts Medicare and Medicaid, and works with many Medicare Advantage and managed care plans.
- Registered nurses on duty 24/7; onsite Medical Director and Director of Nursing; on-staff registered dietitian.
- In-house physical, occupational and speech therapy.
- Services: skilled nursing, short-term rehabilitation, wound care, IV therapy, dementia and Alzheimer's care, post-hospital extended care, hospice/respite/GIP services, social services, activities.
